# Source

Four unmodified Arduino libraries, pinned; origins, tags, commits and licenses in `SOURCES.txt`, checksums in `CHECKSUMS.sha256` (`shasum -a 256 -c CHECKSUMS.sha256`). Moved here from `mspm0g3507/arduino-compat/libraries/` on 2026-10-07; our Arduino API layer that uses them is `portability/arduino/`.
